name: agent-council
description: Route substantive work to cost-effective model tiers and add evidence gates when risk warrants them.

interface.shortDescription: Route substantive work to the right model tier.
interface.longDescription: Agent Council routes bounded engineering, research, strategy, business, and document work to a cost-effective model tier. It keeps routine routing lightweight and opens a governed Council case only when qualifying risk requires independent review, evidence collection, and fail-closed completion gates.
defaultPrompt: Use Agent Council to route this work cost-effectively and apply governance only when risk warrants it.
